stewards.name: FIDO Alliance
stewards.role: Develops agent-commerce specifications from the AP2 contribution in its Payments Technical Working Group (chaired by Mastercard and Visa) since the 2026-04-28 donation; a separate Agentic Authentication Technical Working Group covers agent authentication. No public deliverable was found as of 2026-10-21.

stewards.name: Google (google-agentic-commerce)
stewards.role: Created AP2 (announced 2025-09-16); keeps the GitHub samples and SDK.

implementers.name: Universal Commerce Protocol
implementers.role: Specifies the AP2 extension dev.ucp.common.payment.ap2_mandate; live use unverified.

implementers.name: Google products (Gemini Spark first)
implementers.role: Google said on 2026-05-19 it would begin bringing AP2 to its products in the coming months.

implementers.name: PayPal Agent (Google Cloud and PayPal merchant solution)
implementers.role: Announced on 2025-10-27 as checkout in line with AP2 over A2A; the post describes v0.1 mandates; live use unverified.

implementers.name: Mastercard Verifiable Intent
implementers.role: Aligned mandate format co-developed with Google and contributed to FIDO.

implementers.name: Suede Agent Studio
implementers.role: Self-reported merchant-side v0.2 deployment in issue 345; not independently verified.

implementers.name: Launch collaborators (Adyen, American Express, Coinbase, Mastercard, PayPal, Worldpay and others)
implementers.role: Named in the 2025-09-16 launch post; being named is not deployment.

sdks.name: ap2 Python SDK (in repository)
sdks.note: Installed from source; not published by Google to PyPI.

sdks.name: ap2 (third party)
sdks.note: Belongs to an unrelated third party, not Google.

Primary sources showing live use of AP2 mandates.

costs.whoPays: Nobody: costs are those of the underlying rail (card, bank transfer or x402)
costs.caveat: AP2 carries authorization evidence and prices nothing; rail fees still apply.

costs.item: Google fee for AP2 inside UCP
costs.value: Not published; Google told The Register it does not plan to take a cut of sales closed through its own agentic checkout
costs.caveat: Secondary reporting about UCP, not an AP2 fee.

costs.item: Second signing key type for merchants
costs.caveat: Issue 268 calls the ECDSA rule a composition cost for merchants that already sign with Ed25519.
